title: Order-Origin Courtesy on Delayed Home Delivery Pharmacy Orders
content:
## Training note: what started the delayed order

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy dispensing-delay credit, an order-origin courtesy amount is added by what initiated the delayed order: 4.00 for an order placed for a new prescription, 2.00 for an automatic refill order, and nothing for any other order.

### Questions answered

**Where is the origin shown?** On the placed order, which records what initiated it: a new prescription, a member request or an automatic refill.

**What does an order the member requested earn?** Nothing; only new-prescription and automatic refill orders earn an origin courtesy.

**How is the courtesy used?** It is added to the credit.

### Origin table

| Delayed order was initiated by | Courtesy |
|---|---|
| a new prescription | 4.00 |
| an automatic refill | 2.00 |
| anything else | nothing |
